questions.question: A compound has a five-membered ring containing one oxygen atom and two C=C bonds. Identify the compound and draw its structure. Explain why it is classified as an aromatic heterocycle. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• A compound has a five-membered ring containing one oxygen atom and two C=C
  • bonds. Identify the compound and draw its structure. Explain why it is classified
  • as an aromatic heterocycle.
  • The compound is furan.
  • Furan is considered aromatic because it forms a planar, cyclic ring with a continuously
  • conjugated system of six pi electrons, fulfilling Hückel's rule . One of the lone pairs on the
  • oxygen atom resides in a p -orbital and delocalizes into the ring, completing the aromatic sextet
  • alongside the four pi electrons from the two carbon-carbon double bonds.
  • (Correct name and structure: 1+1 marks and for correct explanation -3 marks)
